findings.text: Top level core dump driver invoked with fatal signal info; snapshots limits and process dump state, audits event, applies eligibility screening, prepares elevated credentials with special handling for tainted cases, coordinates multi-thread rendezvous, then runs formatted dump under those credentials and releases resources.
Public safety check warning when privileged dump mode is combined with a pattern that is neither absolute path nor pipe nor socket request; encourages ordering of configuration.

Path rendering helpers that build printable strings backward into caller buffer and return start of result or failure indicator; one resolves relative to supplied root while other resolves against absolute filesystem root with distinct handling for escaping paths.

Dentry name formatting utilities producing printable paths with markers for removed or unlinked entries; variants differ in whether deletion annotation is added and whether rename protection is required.

Direct access folio coordination interface allowing callers to obtain stable locked mapping entry for a folio and later release it; handles device character mappings as trivially pinned and regular file mappings via page cache index lookup, plus helper to dismantle compound folio state on release.

System call returning current working directory string into user buffer; uses temporary kernel page, samples root and working directory under read side protection, annotates unreachable case, validates length against limits and copies out with standard error reporting.
Early boot initializers registering core dump control table under kernel namespace and preparing fixed size wait queue array for direct access entry waiting.
Small backward growing string accumulator holding current write pointer and remaining length; callers prepend terminator then components and finally extract contiguous result.
Wait identity for direct access exceptional entries pairing owning page cache with aligned start index, carried inside queue element that also embeds generic wait linkage for selective wakeup.

Core destination selector with file pipe and socket families plus request variant; after successful setup it honors mask bits controlling rejection kernel generation userspace notification and helper synchronization with per type wait primitive.
Direct access entry state encoded as bit flags distinguishing locked huge zero and empty conditions with order derived from huge bit; wake policy chooses between single successor and broadcast.

Dentry path walk runs under read copy update with optimistic sequence protection against concurrent renames; restarts on retry indication and adjusts read protection handling according to sequence state.
Process root and working directory pair sampled with sequence retry loop to obtain consistent snapshot without exclusive locking, used under read side protection by working directory retrieval.

Direct access entry lookup and locking serializes on page cache spin protection with interrupt state saved; waiters enqueue with selective wake function, drop protection while sleeping, then reacquire and revalidate entry before proceeding.
Simple deleted name formatting requires no directory lock because target dentries are never renamed.
Dump eligibility requires present formatter with dump callback and dumpable state other than fully disabled.
Termination always closes open dump file if any, releases global pipe accounting only for pipe type, frees generated name and reports completion status.

Socket style patterns must live in initial mount namespace, use absolute location with optional request prefix, respect unix path length bound and forbid parent traversal components; non socket patterns bypass checks.

Core pattern updates preserve prior value, delegate to generic string handler, restore old value and reject invalid socket specifications, and trigger safety review only when effective pattern changed.
Virtual area metadata comparator orders strictly by recorded dump size returning negative zero or positive accordingly.

Unlinked dentries receive explicit textual annotation rather than silent success, and absolute path helper signals invalid argument when path escapes expected root while working directory retrieval annotates unreachable paths.
Wait queue selected by hash of page cache identity mixed with index aligned down to huge page boundary for huge entries, ensuring all offsets within same huge range share one queue and key.

Association ignores zero and empty placeholders; first shared use converts exclusive folio to shared form and bumps share count while exclusive use initializes compound state and records owning mapping and file index; disassociation and busy checks similarly ignore placeholders.

Folio release clears mapping and shared union word, restores device mapping association, splits compound folios back to order zero pages with per page state cleared, returning original order for verification.
Wakeup callback only wakes waiters whose stored cache and start match signaled key, otherwise leaves them queued.

Conversion between table values and frame numbers shifts by flag width while preserving flag bits; predicates test individual flag bits and order helper maps huge entries to middle directory order and others to zero, with size helper returning zero for placeholder kinds.

Shared folio release decrements share count and only dismantles compound state when last reference drops; exclusive folios dismantle immediately with debug verification that sub page references are clear.
Unlocked entry handoff wakes waiters unless entry is missing or carries conflict marker, with caller selected wake scope.
Combining privileged dump mode with relative pattern risks uncontrolled file creation; implementation emits warning directing administrator to use absolute or pipe configuration.

Working directory retrieval can fail for allocation shortage, unlinked directory, overlong result, undersized user buffer, or faulting destination; unreachable paths are annotated rather than treated as fatal.

Conflict markers and internal entries require special handling; callers must not assume loaded entry remains stable across sleep and must revalidate after wait, with smaller than requested order treated as retry signal.
Wait table sizing uses twelve hash bits yielding power of two queue count.
Direct access value encoding reserves low four bits for flags with shift of four for frame number; locked uses lowest bit, huge next, zero next, empty next.
Huge page helpers derive colour mask and page count from ratio of middle directory size to base page size.
Placeholder size marker for optional header accounting has value one.
Temporary pathname buffers allocate path maximum bytes with kernel allocation and release via single free.

Core controls expose six entries under kernel namespace with read write access except read only mode list; names cover pid suffix pattern pipe limit note size limit address ordering and mode list, with bounded ranges for limit and boolean controls.
Direct access compilation enables trace point creation marker.
